chapters.reason: The paper formulates reasoning as a utility maximization problem with an inference budget constraint, training the model to allocate budgets based on query difficulty.
The model is fine-tuned to learn to understand query difficulty and produce reasoning chains that align with allocated budgets, effectively compressing or expanding chains based on need.
The core objective is to make models aware of inference budgets and adaptively allocate them, which aligns with the definition of difficulty-adaptive budget allocation.
